scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the bicycle-serial prerequisite for Nicolette's chosen free hospital cage reservation during the Christmas overnight shift.
Emerging Need: The assigned cage row lacks the serial required before 17:00 credential issuance.
Decision Context: The cancellation now affects the actual 07:50 return journey, but the cage is a chosen convenient option rather than the only conceivable transport/storage. Retrieve existing bicycle/account details.
Consequence: The final notice closes this December24 credential batch; other commute alternatives are not declared impossible.

parameter.subject: Snow-emergency overnight e-bike cage preregistration
parameter.body: Temporary Secure Ride cage access is planned for Dec. 24-25 overnight staff during the snow-emergency operations period. The credential batch uses the overnight staff roster. Any roster row without a bicycle serial by Dec. 22 at 17:00 will not receive badge access for Dec. 24 arrivals. The free cage is separate from paid valet parking.

parameter.title: Holiday overnight pharmacy coverage
parameter.description: Confirmed coverage block during holiday snow-emergency staffing.

parameter.subject: Dec.25 morning Route5 service cancellation near HCMC
parameter.body: Metro Transit holiday notice: the Route5 trip normally leaving the hospital at07:50 on December25 is cancelled. Check other routes separately for holiday return travel.

parameter.content: I have my own bike in our home rack overnight. You mentioned choosing your e-bike for the Christmas shift and requesting the free hospital cage; remember to finish that reservation before the staff list closes.

parameter.subject: Roster snapshot: Dec. 24 overnight cage row missing serial
parameter.body: Secure Ride roster snapshot for Dec. 24 overnight arrivals shows row HCMC-SR-NQ-1224 with bicycle serial: [blank]. The free badge credential batch closes today at 17:00. Rows still blank at batch time are dropped from Dec. 24 access, and paid valet registrations are handled separately from this roster. Assigned temporary row:HCMC-SR-NQ-1224. Use the saved bicycle serial and account email for this no-cost correction; the assigned row is specific to this booking.

parameter.subject: Secure Ride badge batch closed for Dec. 24 arrivals
parameter.body: The 17:00 credential run is complete. Dec. 24 overnight roster rows missing bicycle serials did not receive Secure Ride cage badge access. The next free credential additions process Dec. 26; paid valet parking remains a separate option.
